scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof is valid for all prime powers and all tuple lengths; exhaustive finite checks do not replace the universal proof. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact orbit-size formula for commuting tuples in finite-field graphical groups only; not arbitrary tuples or general class-two groups. Existing k=1 special case and general higher-conjugacy concepts are acknowledged. Possible equivalent unindexed literature remains.
title: Higher commuting-tuple conjugacy for finite graphical groups
